items.name: Cross-platform native apps
items.note: Tauri 2 desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux

items.name: Installer and portable packages
items.note: tauri.conf.json bundle targets "all" (msi, nsis, dmg, deb, rpm, AppImage); no signing config

items.name: Headless server deployment
items.note: No server process; the app only runs as a desktop window
items.evidence: ufop-server binary serves the web UI and REST API headless; Chromium E2E: sign in, create job, back up, restore byte-identical (src-tauri/src/server, src/components/server)

items.name: Independent command-line operation
items.note: ufop backup … in cli/src/commands/backup.rs, works without the app

items.name: Desktop tray integration
items.note: No tray icon or tray menu

items.name: Docker deployment
items.note: Docker files exist only for the marketing site

items.name: OS service and login startup
items.note: No autostart or service; schedules run only while the app is open

items.name: Native OS notifications
items.note: tauri-plugin-notification is loaded, but backup results don't trigger it

items.name: Local job dashboard
items.note: Backups panel: last result, versions, sizes, next run, actions

items.name: API-only or custom web interface
items.evidence: ufop-server binary serves the web UI and REST API headless; Chromium E2E: sign in, create job, back up, restore byte-identical (src-tauri/src/server, src/components/server)

items.name: Named backup jobs and setup wizard
items.note: 7-step wizard: name, sources, destination, schedule, retention, options, hooks

items.name: Job editing and controlled deletion
items.note: Delete with separate choices for local DB and remote data

items.name: Source picker
items.note: Native folder picker plus preview of selected files (not a full tree browser)

items.name: Source and filter text editing
items.note: Sources as text; filters editable as +/− text lines

items.name: Destination connection tests
items.note: Test, test & create folder, and a randomized compatibility test

items.name: Advanced settings editor
items.note: Typed fields for every engine option (not free-form option strings)

items.name: Global defaults with per-job overrides
items.note: Each job holds its own options; no shared defaults

items.name: Protected configuration export
items.note: Passphrase omitted unless chosen; whole export can be encrypted

items.name: Configuration statistics import
items.note: Optional stats import; save immediately or review first

items.name: Command-line configuration export
items.note: backup_export_cli generates the ufop backup run command

items.name: Remote configuration storage
items.note: store_config_remotely embeds the job in each file list

items.name: Stored-configuration secret policy
items.note: Always strips secrets; no selectable modes

items.name: Remote configuration discovery
items.note: Read stored config from a destination and recreate the job

items.name: Migration and history continuation
items.note: Local DB can be rebuilt from remote; no guided migration

items.name: Reusable destination connections
items.note: Saved connections are reused; no separate destination library

items.name: Exact-path include/exclude
items.note: File vs folder matching via trailing slash

items.name: Predefined exclusion groups
items.note: temporary, cache, OS metadata, system, build artifacts

items.name: Ordered filter evaluation
items.note: First match wins; an excluded folder prunes traversal

items.name: File-attribute exclusions
items.note: Hidden (dotfiles and Windows attribute), system, temporary

items.name: Folder exclusion markers
items.note: Any marker file; CACHEDIR.TAG only with its signature

items.name: Missing and empty source safeguards
items.note: Fail or warn on missing source; empty versions refused by default

items.name: File-change detection controls
items.note: Disable timestamp shortcut, or trust timestamps only

items.name: Metadata preservation
items.note: Modification time and Unix mode only; no Windows attributes or ACLs

items.name: Incremental backups
items.note: Unchanged files reuse earlier blocks; live test uploaded 689 B after a one-line change

items.name: Block-level deduplication
items.note: SHA-256 blocks shared across files and versions

items.name: Compression level and method
items.note: Deflate level 0–9 (0 = store); not ZIP containers

items.name: ZIP implementation and ZIP64
items.note: Own volume format instead of ZIP

items.name: Deduplication block size
items.note: Fixed at creation; changes refused after the first version

items.name: File-list manifests and index volumes
items.note: dlist and dindex volumes (index always on)

items.name: Last-version safeguard
items.note: Newest version never deleted unless full removal is allowed

items.name: Post-backup expiration
items.note: Retention runs after each successful backup

items.name: Unchanged-version suppression
items.note: No new version when nothing changed (overridable)

items.name: Remote-volume compaction
items.note: Auto and manual; deletes unused volumes, repacks sparse ones

items.name: Sampled or full verification
items.note: Sample count or every volume, optional per-block hash check

items.name: External verification manifest
items.note: Unencrypted list of sizes and SHA-256 hashes

items.name: Partial versions from interrupted backups
items.note: Cancel/interrupt writes a version marked partial

items.name: Granular historical restore
items.note: Pick version, files, folders or wildcards

items.name: Restore without the original installation
items.note: Direct restore with location and passphrase only

items.name: Restore from exported configuration
items.note: Import config, then restore through the job

items.name: File search and version listing
items.note: Search across all versions (substring or wildcard)

items.name: Restore destination and conflicts
items.note: Original or other folder; overwrite, rename with timestamp, or skip

items.name: Symlink metadata restoration
items.note: Links recreated (Unix); their metadata is not

items.name: Local block reuse, correct-file skipping
items.note: Matching files skipped; local blocks not reused

items.name: Restore integrity checks
items.note: Every restored file hash-checked; skip_verify for recovery

items.name: Best-effort continuation
items.note: Damaged volumes reported; other files still restored

items.name: Per-job local database
items.note: One SQLite file per job, separate from the app DB

items.name: Database recreation and repair
items.note: Recreate from remote; repair re-uploads missing index and file lists

items.name: Temporary restore database
items.note: In-memory DB built from remote for direct restore

items.name: Repository consistency checking
items.note: Before each backup and on demand

items.name: Selective file purging
items.note: Purge paths or wildcards from history

items.name: Database schema migration tool
items.note: App migrations only; no standalone tool
